name: readme-order-rolled-back
description: README step 5 / IT message.xml: the order is inserted, TestComponent throws MyException, the transactional scope rolls back the insert and the 'out' send, and the message is redelivered. Deliveries 1-3 run the scope (3 inserts executed, all rolled back); delivery 4 has been redelivered 3 times, which exceeds maxRedelivery=2, so MessageRedeliveredException is logged and the message is consumed. orders stays empty (IT: count(*)=0), nothing reaches 'out', nothing is left on 'in' or dead-lettered.

source.reference: using-transactional-scope-in-jms-to-database/README.md steps 5-6 ('has been redelivered 3 times ... exceeds the maxRedelivery setting of 2'; 'no record was inserted'); src/main/app/transactions.xml (maxRedelivery="2", multi-transactional insert -> TestComponent -> jms out); src/test/java/org/mule/examples/UsingTransactionalScopeInJMStoDatabaseIT.java (expects [{count(*)=0}]); src/test/resources/message.xml
